## Summary

Describe the user-visible or operational outcome and why this change is needed.

## Verification

List the commands, tests, manual checks, or screenshots used to verify the change.

## Documentation checklist

- [ ] I updated the README or deeper docs when behavior, architecture, setup, security, or operations changed.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where practical.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for secrets, credentials, personal data, and generated artifacts.
- [ ] I kept the change focused and called out any deliberate follow-up work.
